Question 1: Relationship between vehicle type and ride distance(maybe use facet_wrap for visualization)
Question 2: Relationship between driver rating and vehicle time of arrival

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


```{r}

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
uber_data <- read.csv(" ")

head(uber_data)
summary(uber_data)
```


```{r}
uber_clean <- uber_data %>% 
  mutate(
    Date = ymd(Date),
    Time = hms(Time),

    Avg.VTAT = na_if(Avg.VTAT, "NA"),
    Avg.CTAT = na_if(Avg.CTAT, "NA"),
    Cancelled.Rides.by.Customer = na_if(Cancelled.Rides.by.Customer, "NA"),
    Incomplete.Rides = na_if(Incomplete.Rides, "NA"),
    Booking.Value = na_if(Booking.Value, "NA"),
    Ride.Distance = na_if(Ride.Distance, "NA"),
    Driver.Ratings = na_if(Driver.Ratings, "NA"),
    Customer.Rating = na_if(Customer.Rating, "NA"),



    Avg.VTAT = as.numeric(Avg.VTAT),
    Avg.CTAT = as.numeric(Avg.CTAT),
    Cancelled.Rides.by.Customer = as.numeric(Cancelled.Rides.by.Customer),
    Incomplete.Rides = as.numeric(Incomplete.Rides),
    Booking.Value = as.numeric(Booking.Value),
    Ride.Distance = as.numeric(Ride.Distance),
    Driver.Ratings = as.numeric(Driver.Ratings),
    Customer.Rating = as.numeric(Customer.Rating),
    USD.Value = round(Booking.Value / 88.23, 2)
    
  )
head(uber_clean)
view(uber_clean)
```
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
uber_clean <- uber_data %>% drop_na(Avg.VTAT, Avg.CTAT, Vehicle.Type, Ride.Distance)


```

```{r}
uber_clean <- uber_data[, -c(11, 12, 13, 14,15,16,21)]

view(uber_clean)
```

```{r}
uber_clean <- uber_clean %>% 
  mutate(
    Driver.Ratings = as.numeric(Driver.Ratings),
    Avg.VTAT = as.numeric(Avg.VTAT)
  )
cor(uber_clean$Driver.Ratings, uber_clean$Avg.VTAT, use = "complete.obs")
```










```{r}
set.seed(123)  # for reproducibility
uber_sample <- uber_clean %>% sample_n(1000)  # take 5,000 random rows

ggplot(uber_sample, aes(x = Avg.VTAT, y = Driver.Ratings)) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.4, width = 0.3, height = 0.05, color = "black") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "red") +
  labs(title = "Driver Ratings vs. Vehicle Arrival Time (Sample of 1,000)",
       x = "Average Vehicle Time at Arrival (minutes)",
       y = "Driver Rating") +
  theme_minimal()



```

```{r}
set.seed(123)  # for reproducibility
uber_sample <- uber_clean %>% sample_n(1000)  # take 5,000 random rows

ggplot(uber_sample, aes(x = Avg.CTAT, y = Customer.Rating)) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.4, width = 0.3, height = 0.05, color = "black") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "red") +
  labs(title = "Customer Ratings vs. Customer Arrival Time (Sample of 1,000)",
       x = "Average Customer Time at Arrival (minutes)",
       y = "Customer Rating") +
  theme_minimal()
```
